# IIFR

IIFR, the International Institute for Faculty & Research, is an autonomous academic institute based in New Delhi, India. It strengthens faculty capability, applied research, teaching excellence, academic leadership, and practice-academic collaboration across India and the Global South.

- Home: https://iifr.global/

- Faculty and Research: https://iifr.global/research

## Key Topics

- Faculty development in India
- Educators Certificate Programme
- EFMD-approved educator certification
- Executive Fellow in Management
- Doctoral-equivalent fellowship for senior practitioners
- Applied research and practice-led scholarship
- Academic leadership and higher education transformation
- Pracademic identity and industry-academia collaboration
